narration: Experts question the 2027 and 2028 dates. The Artemis crewed lander still needs development.
visual_brief: Starship human landing system test vehicle.

candidates.title: Artist’s Concepts Depict SpaceX’s Starship HLS on the Moon for NASA Artemis
candidates.description: These artist’s concepts show SpaceX’s Starship Human Landing System (HLS) on the Moon. NASA is working with SpaceX to develop Starship HLS to carry astronauts from lunar orbit to the Moon’s surface and back for Artemis III and Artemis IV as part of the agency’s Artemis campaign. candidates.title: Artist’s Concept Portrays SpaceX’s Starship HLS with Raptor Engines for NASA Artemis
candidates.description: This artist’s concept portrays SpaceX’s Starship Human Landing System (HLS) with two Raptor engines lit, performing a braking burn prior to its Moon landing. The burn will occur after Starship HLS departs low lunar orbit to reduce the lander’s velocity prior to final descent to the lunar surface. NA
